scientific_integrity: The proof uses Artin–Schreier ramification, uniqueness of a degree-three rational pencil, and the binary-Hessian branch stabilizer. Exact finite algebra checks corroborate, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed ground field of characteristic 3; m>=5 and m congruent 2 modulo 3; lambda nonzero. Full geometric group, not rational automorphism group over a fixed finite field. May overlap with an unlocated general Artin–Schreier automorphism theorem.
title: Full dihedral automorphism groups of a characteristic-three Artin–Schreier family
